|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Rose Tico (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-L-rosetico-2022-07-10.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V9-L-rosetico-2022-07-10-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V9-L-rosetico-2018-07-08.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V9-L-rosetico-2022-07-10-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V9-L-rosetico-2022-07-10.png]], 10 July 2022).
* '''Original''' ([[Rose Tico]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-rosetico022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rosetico.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/rosetico.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). During your control phase, if present at a battleground site, and another Resistance character on table (or Paige out of play), may retrieve 1 Force.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-rosetico6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rosetico.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/rosetico.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Text: “If Finn is about to be lost from same site, may place him in Used Pile instead. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Rose Tico (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 12 December 2022<ref name="img-rosetico12d0bca">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rosetico.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c commit 12d0bca] (12 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Light/large/rosetico.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
